info.name: Mobile2
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the unite-mobile2 BFF, targeting the QC4 environment.

Base URL: https://unite-bff-wtn.qc4.unite529.com
All business endpoints are under /mobile2api/v1 and require a member JWT (2-factor).

USAGE:
1. Select the 'unite-mobile2 QC4' environment.
2. Run '00 - Auth > Login (mobile member session)'. It stores {{jwtToken}} automatically.
3. Run any other request (they inherit Bearer {{jwtToken}} + X-App-Version).

Login flow (from the api-test-automation framework):
POST /mobile1api/v1/mobilemembersession with { planId, username, password } and header X-App-Version -> returns _embedded.item.jwtToken.

QC4 verified credentials (non-IDP, proven working): planId hawaii / username lromero / password Test@123 / X-App-Version 3.1.0.

VERIFICATION (run against QC4 on 2026-06-26): Login + all 19 GET endpoints returned 200 OK. The only non-200 is 'GET mobilemembers/{planId}/{username}', which requires the internal ACCEPTANCE_TEST role and returns 401 with a member JWT by design (not a defect).
